name: LiveBench
intro: LiveBench是一个为大型语言模型设计的基准测试，旨在抵抗测试集污染和評審偏見。它包含来自最新信息源并频繁更新的问题，能够自动评分，涵盖数学、编程、推理、语言理解、指令遵循和数据分析等多种具有挑战性的任务。

task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 代码生成, 补全
eval_feature: 动态, 实时, 防污染, 零样本
scale: 论文快照含18个任务、6个类别，每月更新
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Code Generation, Completion
build_method_en: Hybrid, Automated Generation, Web Crawling, Expert Curation
intro_en: LiveBench is a benchmark designed for large language models to resist test set contamination and reviewer bias. It includes frequently updated questions from the latest information sources, supports automatic scoring, and covers a range of challenging tasks such as mathematics, programming, reasoning, language understanding, instruction following, and data analysis.
scale_en: Paper snapshot: 18 tasks across 6 categories, updated monthly

drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2406.19314 Sections 1-3 and Appendix A.3. LiveBench builds 18 tasks across math, coding, reasoning, language comprehension, instruction following, and data analysis from two source types: recent competitions, datasets, news, arXiv abstracts, and movie synopses; or harder contamination-limited variants of AMPS, Big-Bench Hard, IFEval, and related tasks. Every task must have objective ground truth and automatic scoring, and prompts request parseable final answers. Monthly updates replace about one sixth of questions, prioritizing old or easy tasks; new questions are delayed one month so one sixth remains private. Single-turn temperature-zero runs receive 0-1 question scores, averaged into task, category, then six-category LiveBench Score.
